events.title: Brooklyn Shakespeare Festival presented by bkONE productions
events.description:
Brooklyn Shakespeare Festival
The Brooklyn Shakespeare Festival returns for an unforgettable weekend celebrating the works of William Shakespeare through bold productions, live entertainment, and unique theatrical experiences.
Presented by brooklynONE productions, this year’s Festival transforms Industry City Courtyard 5/6 into an open-air stage where timeless stories meet contemporary artists in one of Brooklyn’s most exciting cultural destinations.
Headlining the Festival is Shakespeare’s Twelfth Night, one of the Bard’s most beloved comedies. Overflowing with romance, mistaken identities, music, wit, and unforgettable characters, this joyful production anchors a weekend dedicated to celebrating Shakespeare’s enduring legacy.
But the Brooklyn Shakespeare Festival is far more than a single production.
Festival Programming
🎭 Twelfth Night
Our featured production, performed outdoors under the summer sky by an outstanding cast and creative team.
🎙️ Thorn & Petal Stick
Experience the magic of completely improvised Shakespeare with Thorn & Petal Stick, the acclaimed New York company behind the UnScripted Shakespeare Festival. Using audience suggestions, they’ll create an entirely original Shakespearean comedy or tragedy on the spot—meaning no two performances are ever the same.
✨ Special Performance by the 11th Hour Players
Enjoy a special appearance by the 11th Hour Players, adding another exciting interpretation of Shakespeare to this year’s Festival.
Shakespeare After Dark
When the sun sets, the Festival continues indoors.
Join us inside the Tom Kane Theatre for Shakespeare After Dark, an intimate late-night presentation of William Shakespeare’s The Taming of the Shrew.
Performances begin at 10:00 PM on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, offering audiences a darker, closer, and completely different theatrical experience after the excitement of the outdoor Festival. Admission to Shakespeare After Dark is sold separately from the Festival donation.
Whether you’re a lifelong Shakespeare enthusiast or discovering these works for the first time, the Brooklyn Shakespeare Festival offers a full weekend of theatre, comedy, and community.
Festival Highlights
🎭 Headlining production of Twelfth Night
🎙️ Live improvised Shakespeare from Thorn & Petal Stick
✨ Special guest performance by the 11th Hour Players
🌙 Shakespeare After Dark: The Taming of the Shrew at 10:00 PM on Friday, Saturday & Sunday
🌆 Outdoor performances in Industry City Courtyard 5/6
🍽️ Food, drinks, shopping, and entertainment throughout Industry City
💜 Suggested Festival Donation: $10 (Shakespeare After Dark tickets sold separately.)
Join us as we celebrate one of the world’s greatest playwrights through classic theatre, spontaneous comedy, and unforgettable performances—all in the heart of Brooklyn.

events.title: Japanese Antique Fair @IPPIN Project
events.description:
Discover authentic Japanese antiques and one-of-a-kind treasures, handpicked and brought directly from Japan.
Browse a carefully curated collection of timeless pieces, including classic ceramics, handcrafted bamboo baskets, vintage home décor, and unique collectibles. Many of our bamboo baskets were discovered in traditional Japanese homes and date back to the early 20th century, each carrying its own history and craftsmanship.
Alongside our antiques, you’ll find contemporary handmade works by artisans in Japan, including aizome (indigo-dyed) and sashiko textiles, tea leaf–dyed and kakishibu (persimmon tannin)–dyed placemats, handcrafted ceramics, and DAIDAI’s Kurumi Ware—beautiful glassware made with walnut ash, giving each piece its signature soft green hue. A customer favorite from last year, Kurumi Ware is back by popular demand.
Whether you’re a collector or simply appreciate Japanese craftsmanship, you’ll discover timeless pieces that blend tradition, artistry, and everyday beauty.

events.title: Industry City Gourmet Food and Drinks Tour
events.description:
Set against the iconic backdrop of Sunset Park’s historic waterfront, the massive, revitalized structures of Industry City form a breathtaking stage for an exclusive culinary journey. This premium food and cocktail tour is a curated exploration of taste and craft, transforming an evening into a memorable, high-end experience.
Your adventure begins with artistic bonbons at Lilac Chocolates, explores gourmet imports at Sahadi’s, and includes a refined whiskey tasting at Fort Hamilton Distillery, followed by a sophisticated sake flight. Savor additional artisanal discoveries within the awe-inspiring industrial halls.
Perfect as a distinctive date night, this tour is also fully customizable for private groups and corporate retreats. We specialize in tailoring this engaging experience for team-building and client entertainment, making it an ideal one-day corporate outing. A sophisticated mini-vacation for locals and a profound discovery for visitors.

events.title: Rock and Roll Playhouse Plays the Music of David Bowie
events.description:
Click here for tickets: https://wl.eventim.us/event/rock-and-roll-playhouse-plays-the-music-of-david-bowie/694924?afflky=Getitrightthefirsttime
PLEASE NOTE: All children must be accompanied by a parent or adult caregiver. Kids 1 and under are free. Everyone else needs a ticket. We try to keep the volume low, but we strongly encourage ear protection for everyone. Now for the fun stuff!
Industry City and Get It Right Music are proud to welcome The Rock and Roll Playhouse for a series of shows this summer in our outdoor bandshell!
This show features two sets of David Bowie! The first set features Bowie’s greatest hits for the whole family and a second set of some deep cuts for everyone.
The 1:00 pm opening set is the traditional interactive Rock and Roll Playhouse family set with another “all ages” set for everyone’s enjoyment from approximately 2:00-4:00 pm!
Event Info
Date: August 9, 2026
Doors: 12:30pm
Rock and Roll Playhouse set:1:00-2:00pm
Rock and Roll Party for everyone: 2:00-4:00pm
Advance Tickets: $12.50 per person plus fees
Advance: Family of Four-pack: $35 per family plus fees
Day of tickets: $15
Address: Industry City Bandshell Stage, Courtyard 1/2 at Industry City in Brooklyn New York between 36th and 37th street and 2nd and 3rd Avenues.
ENTER 238 36th Street, Brooklyn, NY on your GPS device
The venue is located in an open-air courtyard featuring a full concert sound stage. Fans can order food from over 17 options inside the adjoining food hall. Concert is rain or shine.
How to get here:
Take the D, N, R lines to 36th street station in Brooklyn and walk west one block to Industry City. 3 stops from Manhattan. 30 minutes from Herald Square.
From Long Island, take the LIRR to Atlantic Terminal then take the D, N or R train to 36th street.
More About the Rock and Roll Playhouse
The Rock and Roll Playhouse, a family concert series hosted at historic music venues across the country, allows kids to “move, play and sing while listening to works from the classic-rock canon” (NY Times). Performing songs created by the most iconic musicians in rock history, The Rock and Roll Playhouse band offers its core audience of families with children age ten and under games, movement, stories and an opportunity to rock out in an effort to educate children and explore their creativity. The Rock and Roll Playhouse is an early and often first introduction to a child’s lifelong journey with live music and rock and roll. See you at the show!
This concert for kids and families shares the music of the artist named above with a new generation of music lovers, but is not associated with or endorsed by the artist. All children must be accompanied by a parent or adult caregiver.
The Rock and Roll Playhouse knows that little ears are sensitive, so we turn down the volume at our shows. However, all kids experience music differently and you may find that your child is more comfortable wearing hearing protection earmuffs, such as Baby Banz, which are available for purchase here.
By attending this event, I consent to my image (with or without my voice) being included in photographs and/or film and videotape of the event, and give Brooklyn Bowl, The Rock and Roll Playhouse and their respective licensees and assigns the absolute and irrevocable right and permission to use and publish such content in any and all media, whether now known or hereafter developed.

events.description:
Step away from that bottle of vino and join us to sample the absolute best beverage to pair with cheese – We are talking about sake! If you haven’t yet tried pairing craft sake and premium cheese, you are in for a revelation. We’ll explore a wide range of flavors and textures… and together, we’ll discover the most exciting combinations of sake styles and cheeses from around the world. The experience is fun, interactive and absolutely delicious! Join us at Brooklyn Kura to learn about sake where sake is made!
What’s included:
A welcome sake to get you started!
A brief intro to sake and cheese basics.
Guided Tasting of 5 Japanese craft sakes from different regions paired to perfection with 5 outstanding cheese varieties.
Exploration of sake and cheese production styles and terrior.
Enjoy some nibbles and spreads on your cheese board that will take the pairing over the top.
Handouts so you can bring your newfound sake and cheese knowledge home
Finish with a Guided tour through our new Sake Brewery

events.title: Zine Club
events.description:
Join us every two weeks for Zine Club, a gathering dedicated to DIY bookmaking, self-publishing, creative experimentation, and community. Whether you’re new to zines or working on an ongoing project, this is a space to explore ideas, share work, and be creative in community with other artists, writers, activists, and creatives of all kinds.
Each begins with a quick demo of a technique or process you might incorporate in your own work. Explore a wide range of materials and techniques available in our studio, including collage, drawing, image transfer, stenciling, and printmaking.
Zine Club is led by Lista Studios instructor Wil Bigio, a graphic designer, illustrator, and dedicated doodler based in New York.
Details:
Meets every other Wednesday (first and third of the month) from 6:00 pm – 8:30 pm
Basic materials provided (paper, collage supplies, and printmaking tools)

events.title: Introduction to Shochu – Tasting Class and Brewery Tour
events.description:
Are you curious about Shochu? Join us to learn the basics of this delicious and unique 500+ year old Japanese Spirit, how to differentiate between styles, and how to serve Shochu to its best advantage and use it in delicious craft cocktails. We’ll also explore the nuance of Shochu vs Sake and Soju! The course includes a guided tour of Brooklyn Kura’s sake brewery (through the lens of shochu making), a flight of 5 different shochus served in a variety of styles, and a few snacks to accompany the tasting.
What’s included:
-Shochu 101 presentation to walk you through the fundamentals of the Japanese spirit
-A guided tasting of 4 different Japanese Shochus, as well as Brooklyn Kura’s house-made Shochu
-A Handout/notes section for reference at home
-Snacks to accompany the spirit tasting
-A 10% discount for purchasing bottles at Brooklyn Kura or select bottles at Kuraichi
